text: In the Supreme Court of India, Criminal Appellate Jurisdiction. Appeal filed by Appellant Harish Chandra against the State of Maharashtra. The Bench presided by Hon'ble Justice Dr. D.Y. Chandrachud and Justice Surya Kant heard Senior Advocate Kapil Sibal appearing for the petitioner. The Central Bureau of Investigation submitted chargesheet under Section 120B and Section 409 of Indian Penal Code concerning illicit procurement at Jawaharlal Nehru Port Trust in Navi Mumbai.

court: High Court of Judicature at Bombay
text: Before the High Court of Judicature at Bombay, Criminal Division. Bail Application No. 891 of 2024. In the matter of Elena Rostova versus Directorate of Enforcement (ED). Counsel Abhishek Manu Singhvi appeared on behalf of applicant Elena Rostova concerning allegations under PMLA 2002 connected to Horizon Global Logistics based in Bandra Kurla Complex, Mumbai.
